integrity: Analytical proof, precise domain, explicit parity counterfamily and a reproducible finite consistency checker are included; the checker does not establish global correctness or originality.
scientific_limitations: Uniqueness holds only for strictly convex polygons with the origin interior and every perpendicular support foot strictly inside its edge. No assertion of existence for arbitrary input, nor uniqueness outside this domain. Earlier literature priority is not independently certified.
title: Odd-polygon radial–support rigidity under interior normal feet
